# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 69 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 69

Jesus said: "Blessed are those who have been persecuted in their heart — these are they who have truly known the Father. Blessed are those who are hungry, for the belly of the one who desires will be filled."

---

**Translator's Notes (EMET):**

- Two beatitudes joined: inner persecution and hunger
- "Persecuted in their heart" — interior suffering, not external; the heart (*hēt*) as seat of spiritual struggle
- "Have truly known the Father" — the reward is *gnosis* of the Father, not comfort or kingdom
- Second beatitude parallels Matthew 5:6 / Luke 6:21 but replaces "righteousness" with the literal hunger/filled promise
- "The belly of the one who desires" — *koilia* (belly/womb) used for physical hunger; "desires" (*epithymia*) suggests spiritual longing as well
